PLAY NOTES

Record decisions outside the VP table

The tracker records objective progress and VP only. Use the reference cards for setup, deployment, track end, salvage, and special rules such as scanning, buildings, components, or emplacement counts.

Source boundaryGeneral contract administration, employers, and travel are intentionally excluded. Source-specific cross-track records are included only where a tactical force or contract-victory rule requires them.
RULES SOURCES

Sourcebook and incorporated errata

  • Sourcebook: Hot Spots: Draconis Reach, First Printing.
  • Official master errata reviewed: revision edited by MetalEd on 27 November 2026 at 16:33:26. The official source was verified on 27 November 2026. No formal version number has been published.
  • Mission Foundry reconciliation: review of the current master does not mean every correction is implemented. The Xhosa VII p. 122 exit-edge and victory correction is in the master but remains outstanding in Mission Foundry.
  • Forum follow-ups: post #36 contains an unincorporated Dahar IV contract-identifier report and a master-incorporated Xhosa VII correction that remains outstanding here. Post #37 is administrative. Post #38 is an individual, unincorporated table-heading correction for tables the browser does not render. Post #39’s Track Force and Changing Scale corrections are in the master and implemented. Posts #40–#41 report Discord clarifications and are not published master errata; the Game Worlds Republic team-reroll clarification and the Mallory LINGO correction are implemented.
  • Objective Raid capacity: printed p. 171 gives weight-class/Alpha Strike Size capacity and separate dedicated cargo-space formulas. Pending clarification, Mission Foundry provisionally uses the greater capacity and does not add them. The originating Chat inspected AS:CE v7.01 pp. 84 and 163–164 and BMM p. 21; those general cargo and lifting rules do not conclusively resolve this track-specific interaction. AS:CE v7.02 reconciliation remains pending.
  • Le Blanc Temporary Hires: printed pp. 29 and 89 and the current Track Force errata establish the general eligibility thresholds, Le Blanc’s initial two-thirds availability trigger, and the corrected minimum-force treatment. It remains provisionally unresolved whether Le Blanc’s subsequent-track hiring permission overrides the general p. 29 eligibility thresholds.
  • Le Blanc clarification: NCKestrel confirmed on Discord on 25 November 2026 that Command Complications apply to both Month 3 tracks. The clarification was accepted in the originating Chat and is not published master errata.
  • Alta Vista clarification: the existing mutual-withdrawal continuation follows a previously accepted forum clarification. Its exact author, calendar date, and direct URL are unavailable in the current evidence; it is not published master errata.
  • Mallory supporting source: Draconis Reach pp. 132–142 and the official 2026 Loneliness Island Poster Map. Both local PDFs were directly inspected on 27 November 2026. Alpha Strike: Commander’s Edition v7.01 tabletop, force-building, and scenario pages were inspected in the originating Chat; the linked v7.02 errata returned a publisher server error during that Local Work task. The 15-BSP, PV +25-percent, and 48 × 72-inch battlefield decisions remain provisional in Mallory’s Contract Reference. The Irrigation/LINGO correction is a forum report of a MetalEd Discord clarification from 27 November 2026 at a displayed 8:38 PM; it is not published master errata and its time zone is unknown. MetalEd confirmed on Discord on 28 November 2026 at a displayed 12:23 AM that Mallory’s prescribed force breakdown supersedes ordinary Track Force construction and does not itself require breaking contract. That accepted author clarification is not published master errata, its time zone is unknown, and the original screenshot was inspected in the originating Chat but is unavailable to this Local Work task. Initial command-strength eligibility remains a separate provisional question.
  • Game Worlds supporting sources: Draconis Reach pp. 128–131, 155, 182–201; official 2021 MapPack: Alien Worlds rules booklet, Fungal Crevasse; Alpha Strike: Commander’s Edition Seventh Printing v7.01 pp. 50, 58, 62 with official v7.02 errata; Tactical Operations: Advanced Rules Corrected Sixth Printing pp. 52, 54, 56 with v7.0 errata. NCKestrel’s accepted Discord clarification from 27 November 2026 at a displayed 8:13 PM requires Republic team results to be rerolled; forum post #40 reports that clarification, but it is not published master errata and its time zone is unknown. The AS:CE and TO:AR rulebook pages were directly inspected in the originating Chat; the two linked official publisher PDFs and the local Draconis Reach source were inspected during this task.

Scenario victory and special rules: printed pp. 76–77, 80–81, 104–106, 110–112, general successful completion on p. 29, and Objective Raid on p. 171 were directly inspected on 28 November 2026. Achernar’s independent victory conditions and actual-Strike requirement, Alta Vista’s cargo, Withdrawal Order, and played-Meeting-Engagement rules, Pascagoula’s special tactical-victory precedence, and Protection’s same-player patrol-boat conversion and Mobile HQ override are presented as printed rules rather than errata. Alta Vista simultaneous contract victory, Pascagoula’s surviving-Ryu and successful-completion interactions, and Protection’s Alpha Strike water conversion remain provisional.

The revision date identifies the authoritative master that was reviewed; the verification date records the source check. Incorporated rules, outstanding corrections, individual reports, Discord clarifications, and amber provisional interpretations retain separate status.
